name: appshot
description: AppShot — automated screen capture & page inventory tool for web applications. Point it at any app (URL + credentials), it logs in, walks every screen, captures full-page screenshots of every meaningful state, and emits a PageInventory.md + HTML gallery. Read-only by design.

scripts.ui:build: cd ui/client && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build
